subject.title: Migration-import config merge has no prototype-pollution guard, unlike the sibling config-path writer

question: Should imported migration config patches reject or drop `__proto__`, `constructor`, and `prototype` keys at the shared SDK helper boundary?
rationale: The bug is clear, but the public plugin SDK helper's failure semantics affect bundled and third-party migration providers and should be set deliberately for a security boundary.

options.title: Guard Shared SDK Helper
options.body: Block prototype-bearing keys in `mergeMigrationConfigValue` and `writeMigrationConfigPath`, with tests for direct helper and Hermes provider/MCP/skill imports.

options.title: Filter Hermes Only
options.body: Sanitize Hermes provider/MCP/skill keys locally, which fixes the reported import but leaves other migration providers dependent on caller discipline.

options.title: Accept Trusted Import Risk
options.body: Document tampered prior-tool configs as out of scope and keep the current merge behavior unchanged.

recommendation.title: Guard Shared SDK Helper
recommendation.body: Block prototype-bearing keys in `mergeMigrationConfigValue` and `writeMigrationConfigPath`, with tests for direct helper and Hermes provider/MCP/skill imports.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter's commits introduced the generic migration provider helper and onboarding import path, making him the clearest owner for the SDK boundary decision.
